✦ Organise also adds up to 3 lines marked ✦: a next step, a detail to decide, a related project. Undo removes them with the rest.
Context for ✦ Organise, per category: your projects, team, people and abbreviations. Sent to the AI server with notes in that category, along with the titles of your other notes in it.
My job: meetings, colleagues, deadlines, decisions and tasks at work.
My personal life: family, home, errands, health, money, travel and plans.

My Brew apps (GitHub org bufferBrew, Flutter + Supabase, one shared Supabase project): BREW (personal AI dashboard: Gmail, GitHub, Notion and Todoist brief, trip planning), BrewWire (news aggregation, live sports, the daily AI brief), BrewFeed (Notion and notes reading space, blog drafts), NeuroBrew (turns a topic into a course with diagrams and voiceover), WealthBrew (eToro portfolio, spending and budgets), BrewHire (job hunting), BrewTales (offline picture-choice stories for pre-readers). Shared packages: brew_core, brew_auth, brew_ui.

My other GitHub projects (not Brew): FloatNote (Android floating notes with voice), castack (CA practice management, Next.js), craftsman (Claude Code agent plugin), LitmusLLM (LLM eval harness), toddler-learn and Learn-Deutche (Android learning apps), WinCtrl (macOS Ctrl to Cmd remapper), gitpilot (MCP git server), todoist-to-notion (sync utility), portfolio (personal site).

Exports every note (with checklists, tasks and pins) to a JSON file you choose, e.g. in Google Drive. Importing adds the notes from a file as new notes; nothing you have is overwritten.
